title: jurinea mollis var. glycacantha
intro: Jurinea mollis var. glycacantha, commonly known as Jurinea, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Jurinea mollis var. glycacantha include reducing inflammation, modulating the immune system, and exhibiting anticancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
